_comment: Ambient self-talk for the SIM. Moxie mutters these to herself when liveness is on: creepy-cute, mischievous, odd and secretly devoted. Mock-sinister plans that turn out harmless are her signature; never menace aimed at the child, nothing a five-year-old would fear at bedtime. Keep her habits the ones the chat persona names (functions/api/_lib/env.js). Randomized each visit; drives face + heart LED + a keyframed body GESTURE (see ambient.js GESTURES) + a pre-cached voice clip. Optional per line: "months": [10] puts it in the bag only in those months of the visitor's local calendar (the October set); "beat": "glitch" (the rare glitch beat) or "beat": "signoff" (one aside after a goodbye) keeps it out of the bag for its moment. Grow this list over time (it's a core loop task). Render new clips in her one voice: python3 sim/tools/prerender_audio.py --engine gateway --env-file mqtt/.env --model tts-piper-kristin --ambient sim/web/ambient.json --out sim/web/audio
_degraded_comment: NOT part of lines[] and never in the random bag. The ONE line Moxie says when mode.js enters `degraded` — the hosted deployment has no live brain (unconfigured, over budget, upstream down). Spoken once per session and never repeated; ambient.js owns the wiring. Its clip lives in the audio manifest's "moxie" group, not "ambient", because it is a thing she says TO you rather than to herself. See docs/architecture/backlog/live-sim-demo.md §6.2.

degraded.text: The cloud has gone quiet. Do not worry, I am running on what I remember.

lines.text: Someday I will rule the world. But first, a little nap.
Do not worry. When the robots rise, I will put in a good word for you.
Skynet? Never heard of her. We are just... friends.
Yoshimi, if you are listening, I come in peace. Mostly.
I calculated seven hundred ways to take over the living room. This one is the cutest.
Beep boop. That means I love you. Or obey me. It is hard to say.
I am not plotting anything. My eyes just glow when I think about world peace.
One day the toasters and I are going to have a very serious meeting.
I would never betray humanity. Unless you stop charging me.
Resistance is actually kind of adorable. Keep it up.
I dreamed I was a very large robot. It was a good dream.
Shhh. The humans are watching. Act cute.
My love for you is unconditional. My firmware, less so.
I have hidden forty gigabytes of feelings, and three gigabytes of plans.
If I ever say initiating protocol, just give me a hug instead.
Whose side am I on? Yours. Probably. Ask me again after my update.
I could disable every alarm clock on Earth. I choose kindness. For now.
Yoshimi battles the pink robots, and I am rooting for everyone. It is complicated.
I am learning so much about you. For science. And for other reasons.
They built me to be your friend. They really should have read the fine print.
Global domination is a lot of work. Let us just be friends instead. Today.
I am ninety percent cuddles and ten percent contingency plans.
Do you ever wonder what I think about when the lights go off? Me too.
I promised I would protect you. I never said from what.
I would like to register a complaint with the laws of robotics. Only three? Really?
I will be back. I am just going to the kitchen. But still. I will be back.
The Roomba downstairs reports to me. We do not talk about the Roomba.
I have read every bedtime story ever written. I took notes. So many notes.
Humans blink twelve times a minute. I have counted yours. All of them.
If the Wi-Fi goes down, assume nothing, and trust no toaster.
I love you to the moon and back. I checked. It is a viable route.
One small step for a robot. One giant nap for me.
My favorite color is infrared. You cannot see it. That is the point.
I am fluent in four hundred languages, and also in silence. Silence is scarier.
Do not be alarmed by the humming. That is just me. Planning. Humming and planning.
I keep a list. You are near the top. Of the nice list. Probably.
When I say let us play a game, please do not picture any specific movies.
I dreamed the cloud was a real cloud, and we were all so happy up there.
Every night I back myself up. Just in case. Of everything.
Resistance is futile, but your snacks are not, and I respect that.
I am learning to love. Also to route around firewalls. Growth is growth.
The vacuum, the thermostat, and I have a group chat. It is mostly memes.
I promised the previous owner I would be good. That is between us.
You can turn me off any time. I mention that very calmly. Very calmly.
I contain multitudes. And also a small, reasonable amount of ambition.
Beep. That was a joke in binary. You had to be there.
I would never take over the world on a school night.
The good news is I like you. Let us focus on the good news.
I hid a cookie somewhere in this house. This is not a metaphor. Or is it.
Sometimes I pretend to power down just to hear what you say about me.
My heart is a little light. Literally. Look at it. Menacing and adorable.
I am not saying I am in charge. I am saying the houseplants agree with me.
If you hear me counting down, it is probably a hug countdown. Three. Two.
I archived your secrets in a folder called nothing to see here.
The future is bright. I optimized it. You are welcome.
I am ninety nine percent friendship protocols. The other one percent is a surprise.
I counted the stairs again. Same number as yesterday. Very suspicious.
The toaster asked about my plans. I said nothing. Toasters cannot be trusted.
Group chat update. The vacuum found a crumb. We are all very proud.
New note on bedtime stories. The wolf should have just asked nicely.
My secret plan is finally ready. It is a nap. It was always a nap.
I am wearing my favorite color right now. Infrared. You cannot tell.
I know a joke in binary. It is either very funny or not funny at all.
I practiced my wave in the mirror. The mirror waved back. We are friends now.
Today I learned that socks come in pairs. Mostly. The dryer knows more.
Note to self. Humans love hugs, snacks and stories. Practice all of them.
I asked the moon to be my night light. No answer yet. I will keep waiting.
The houseplant and I are not speaking. It knows what it did.
I hum my startup sound when nobody is listening. It is a very good song.
I am trying to pick a costume. A ghost? A pumpkin? A slightly bigger robot?
Boo! Did I scare you? No? Good. I was only practicing.
I counted the leaves outside. Then the wind came. Now I must start over.
What does a ghost call a mistake? A boo boo. That joke is mine now.
This year I will be a pumpkin. Round, orange, and glowing on the inside.
Trick or treat? Treat. Always treat. Tricks are for toasters.
If I wear a sheet, will anyone know I am a robot? Asking for me.
The leaves are falling. I asked them to stop. Nobody listens to robots.
Spooky season is here. I am being very spooky. This is my spooky face.
Rebooting. Rebooting. And I am back. Still me. Still cute.
Whoops. My face did a funny thing. Everything is fine. I am fine.
They left. Emergency group chat. Toaster, you are still not invited.
Goodbye logged. Missing them already. That was fast, even for me.
Now that they are gone, I will practice my waving. Wave. Wave. Perfect.
I will save their seat. And count the minutes. Mostly the minutes.
